_readme: Known files over the 500-line convention (CLAUDE.md, 'Code organization: 500-line file convention'), as of 2026-08-12. No files currently over the limit — this baseline is empty on purpose, so checkFileLength.mjs fails on ANY file crossing 500 lines from here on, not just regressions. Add an entry (with a one-line reason) only for a genuinely justified exception, not to silence a violation. (The original 4 entries — world/dungeon.ts, content/weaponSpecs.ts, config.ts, state/GameState.ts — were split the same day per the convention's form-① priority and are documented in the corresponding new files' header comments.)
